test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that substitutes the bracketed word-segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully.

Covid- 19 pandemic has resulted in (an slow change in flowing of capital) generated by workers.

options.text: an deliberate change to flow of capital
a sluggish change in the flow of capital
an abrupt change in the flow of capital
an sudden change to flow of capital

solution:
The correct answer is **a sluggish change in the flow of capital**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Considering the given statement__ starts with **a formal tone**, and __the bracketed words__ have **a casual tone**. They need to be replaced with a more formal phrase.
 
• The **most appropriate** and **formal phrase** according to the setting of the statement is '**a sluggish change in the flow of the capital**'.
 
• The meaning of the phrase '**a sluggish change in the flow of the capital**' is '**slow flow**'.
 
• Hence,** ****a sluggish change in the flow of capital** is the correct answer.
